localapi.enabled: Let programs on this PC show progress
localapi.enabledHint: Scripts and tools on this PC can show progress and alerts on the notch with atap push. Nothing outside this PC can reach it.
localapi.onPathHint: So a new terminal can run atap without its full path. Removed again when you turn this off or uninstall Atap.
localapi.card.title: Local API
localapi.card.off: Off. Turn it on above to let programs on this PC use it.
localapi.card.running: On. Programs on this PC can show progress on the notch.
localapi.card.couldNotStart: Could not start: another program uses its name. Restart Atap to try again.
localapi.card.pushWidget: Pushes show only while the Push widget is on.
